news.title: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law
news.summary: Russia registered its first crypto exchanges and custodians, including its largest bank, Sberbank, which plans to launch crypto products on Dec. 1.

news.title: Down but not out. Bitcoin's stair-step bullish trajectory is still intact
news.summary: Bitcoin dipped to around $84,200 on Wednesday but stayed inside its recent range, keeping the broader bullish stair-step trajectory intact.

news.title: DOJ invokes Bitcoin Fog ruling in potential blow to Roman Storm acquittal bid
news.summary: Prosecutors say a recent Bitcoin Fog appeals court ruling supports their argument that Tornado Cash activity in Manhattan was enough to establish venue for parts of Roman Storm’s case in New York.

news.title: Robinhood adds $25 million worth of bitcoin to balance sheet as it deepens crypto push
news.summary: Robinhood SVP Johann Kerbrat says the purchase was intended to signal the company's commitment to the crypto sector.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: U.S. government moves over $100 million in BTC and BNB. A sale hasn't been confirmed
news.summary: Wallets linked to the U.S. government moved millions in crypto on Tuesday, according to data tracked by Arkham.

news.title: Kalshi’s 15-min gold markets overtake Ether just weeks after launch
news.summary: Gold recorded 542 million contracts and an estimated $5 million in fees in September, surpassing Ether’s 318 million contracts and $2.6 million, though Bitcoin remained far ahead.

news.title: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract becomes second Ethereum layer 2 to shut in a week
news.summary: The consumer-focused blockchain will close Dec. 15 after Igloo spent tens of millions supporting it, days after Blast said its own network was no longer worth operating.

news.title: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets
news.summary: The new standard is aimed at regulated stablecoins, funds and bonds whose issuers need identity checks, sanctions controls and other transfer rules built into the asset itself.

news.title: Bitcoin dips below $84,000 as oil jumps on Iranian tanker attacks
news.summary: Bitcoin briefly broke under the level analysts flagged as the point where sellers take over. Oil and the dollar both climbed.

news.title: Bitcoin briefly slides below $84,000 as crypto long liquidations reach $487 million
news.summary: Crypto liquidations amounted to $555.6 million over the past 24 hours, including $487.2 million in long positions, according to CoinGlass.

news.title: Coinbase Pro to return; Deribit integration creates Coinbase Global Exchange
news.summary: Coinbase plans to relaunch Coinbase Pro by year-end and has completed its Deribit integration, creating Coinbase Global Exchange.

news.title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
news.summary: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.

news.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
news.summary: Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company funded Abstract for 18 months but still failed to find product-market fit despite attracting major brands and a community of millions.

news.title: Conduit sues Tether over allegedly freezing $2.8M without explanation
news.summary: The lawsuit alleged that Tether froze USDt funds in a Conduit wallet tied to an investigation launched by Brazilian authorities in 2024.

news.title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
news.summary: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, with Gemini Trust serving as custodian and Winklevoss Capital affiliates eyeing up to a $100 million investment.

news.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Ethereum L2 Abstract to shut down after losing ‘tens of millions’
news.summary: Abstract, the Pudgy Penguins-backed Ethereum L2, will shut down on Dec. 15. Users must bridge assets off before then.

news.title: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond
news.summary: The DIGIT pilot will test distributed ledger technology and onchain settlement for UK sovereign debt, with issuance expected by the first quarter of 2027.

news.title: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
news.summary: The digital ruble’s early uptake comes as BRICS nations explore linking their digital currencies for cross-border trade and payments.

news.title: Bill aims at stopping US lawmaker bets on their own elections ahead of midterms
news.summary: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act will not be addressed before the 2026 US midterms as Congress is on recess until after the election.

news.title: Conduit sues Tether over $2.76 million freeze, says it has ‘no legal entitlement’ to funds
news.summary: Conduit is suing Tether in NY federal court, alleging the USDT issuer froze $2.76 million of its funds for over a year without explanation.

news.title: Affluent investors seen boosting crypto exposure: Survey
news.summary: Most affluent investors across seven countries own and are increasing their crypto holdings despite financial advisers who remain overly cautious about digital assets.

news.title: Bitcoin grinds toward $87K as US equities hit new record highs
news.summary: Bitcoin price action was kept in check by overhead ask liquidity while US stocks broke out to new all-time highs.

news.title: Securitize stock jumps 8% amid South Korea tokenization push
news.summary: The LG CNS partnership gives Securitize a foothold as the Seoul prepares new rules for tokenized stocks, bonds and funds beginning in February 2027.

news.title: Peter Thiel-backed Founders Fund leads a $5 million token buy in crypto collateral protocol Anvil
news.summary: Pantera Capital and Bullish also participated in the ANVL purchase as Anvil rolls out software designed to make its collateral protocol easier for businesses to integrate.

news.title: Crypto is expanding the boundaries of what can be priced
news.summary: The future of crypto may therefore depend less on creating the next novel asset and more on building the infrastructure required to price a growing universe of existing ones, argues Altius co-founder and CEO Annabelle Huang.

news.title: Winklevoss group seeks to launch Zcash ETF with 0.25% fee, proposed WINK ticker
news.summary: Winklevoss Asset Services filed for a spot Zcash ETF under ticker WINK, with Gemini as custodian and a 0.25% fee, rivaling Grayscale's ZCSH.

news.title: ECB policymaker warns of fragmentation without digital euro
news.summary: A ECB executive board member said the potential introduction of a digital euro would not ”take over the role of banks,” but ensure they have a role in the EU’s monetary system.

news.title: Ripple expands Brevan Howard deal with prime brokerage services
news.summary: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing services to funds managed by the $35 billion alternative investment manager.

news.title: OKX draws investment from StanChart, Circle, Ripple as it pushes beyond crypto exchange roots
news.summary: The exchange is increasingly aiming to position itself as a global financial tech platform spanning crypto, payments and tokenized assets, following an investment and joint venture with NYSE parent ICE.

news.title: Solana treasury DeFi Development authorizes CHAD preferred stock buyback program
news.summary: Solana treasury firm DeFi Development approved an open-ended program to repurchase CHAD preferred stock if it trades below its $10 par value.

news.title: Brevan Howard to use Ripple Prime for multi-asset brokerage, clearing and financing
news.summary: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing to Brevan Howard, deepening a tie that began with its Ripple investment.

news.title: Polymarket rolls out V2 upgrade with single ERC-1155 positions contract, pUSD collateral
news.summary: Polymarket rolls out Protocol V2, replacing its legacy Gnosis-based setup with a single ERC-1155 positions contract and pUSD collateral.

news.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
news.summary: Sepolia marks one of the final major rehearsals before the final activation of Glamsterdam, aimed at bringing more efficiency and scalability to the Ethereum mainnet.

news.title: OKX exchange raises fresh capital at $25B valuation
news.summary: OKX raised an undisclosed amount at a $25 billion valuation as an extension to March’s investment round led by the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange.

news.title: Capital starting to rotate back to crypto from AI: Raoul Pal
news.summary: Real Vision founder Raoul Pal says a pause in the AI stock rally could help crypto attract capital, while AI agents are likely to boost Ethereum and Solana adoption.

news.title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
news.summary: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

news.title: US crypto rules need to survive the next election
news.summary: US crypto rules could be vulnerable to political change after the midterms. Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo argues Congress needs to pass durable, bipartisan legislation.

news.title: Paxos’ $3B USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum
news.summary: Paxos’ USDG stablecoin is now live on Arbitrum as the network proposes 100 million ARB in incentives to support adoption and liquidity.

news.title: Fortitude expands Zcash mining push with up to $100 million equipment commitment
news.summary: Fortitude secured priority access to BITMAIN’s next-generation Zcash miners as it expands capacity and increases financing from DCG.

news.title: Polymarket overhauls smart contracts with new Protocol V2 rollout
news.summary: Polymarket begins its Protocol V2 rollout ahead of a planned November transition for new prediction markets, while existing positions remain on the current system.

news.title: Self-styled 'Godfather' gets 6 years in prison for $37 million Meta fraud scheme
news.summary: Adam Iza’s sentence runs concurrently with a 15-year term imposed last month for his role in an attempted bitcoin robbery.

news.title: Rep. Don Davis introduces bill to stop federal candidates trading prediction market contracts tied to their own elections
news.summary: Don Davis introduced legislation barring federal candidates and their families from trading prediction contracts tied to their own elections.

news.title: The VIX of bonds is rising but bitcoin and stocks aren't hearing it yet
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 6, 2026

news.title: Spiko raises $90 million to expand tokenized cash funds across markets
news.summary: Spiko raised $90 million in Series B funding to scale its $2.7 billion tokenized cash fund business and expand into new markets.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin remains locked in range as stocks notch another new record high
news.summary: FxPro says a slide below $84,000 would hand control to sellers and put $80,000 in play. Minutes from the Fed's last meeting come out Wednesday.

news.title: Smaller altcoins shine as bitcoin stills trades around $85,000
news.summary: Leading the gains is BTW, the native token of Bitway, a bitcoin-compatible layer-1, which jumped 25% in the past 24 hours and is up 170% over the past 30 days.

news.title: Hong Kong officials double down on end-2026 deadline for crypto licensing bill
news.summary: Hong Kong regulators plan to establish a licensing regime for four categories, including digital asset trading, custody, advisory and management services.

news.title: Binance BTC outflows hit highest since mid-2023 as whales deposit stablecoins
news.summary: Binance BTC reserves fell by nearly 40,000 coins since Sept. 20 as whales returned stablecoin capital to their exchange wallets.

news.title: ZachXBT says he fronted $349,700 to infiltrate alleged Chinese launderers tied to Lazarus, Bybit hack
news.summary: Posing as a client, ZachXBT said he gathered intelligence that helped freeze funds tied to the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.

news.title: Ondo launches onchain private-company exposure, starting with AI
news.summary: Ondo Finance launched a private-markets platform with tokenized notes tied initially to a pre-IPO artificial intelligence company.

news.title: U.S.- China AI race heats up as Chinese rivals secure billions ahead of IPOs
news.summary: DeepSeek and Moonshot attract fresh capital ahead of planned listings, while OpenAI courts major investors.

news.title: Ondo opens private markets with tokenized pre-IPO AI exposure
news.summary: Ondo’s tokenized notes will give eligible investors exposure to private companies, with the first tied to an unnamed pre-IPO AI company.

news.title: OKX looks to abstract blockchain mechanics to bring stablecoin balances to everyday consumers
news.summary: OKX appears to be designing products to keep the blockchain element abstracted or out of sight for users who simply want to hold digital dollars and use a card.

news.title: Why bitcoin is down 'just' 32% a year after its record high of $126,000
news.summary: This shallower decline isn’t limited to the one-year anniversary. The bear market itself has been milder with past downturns seeing prices plummet 77% to 85%.

news.title: U.S. scraps proposed $10,000 reporting rule for for crypto sent to private wallets
news.summary: FinCEN withdrew two proposals that had hung over self-custody and crypto mixers for years without ever taking effect.

news.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test gets last-minute fix before major capacity jump
news.summary: One of Ethereum’s main validator clients updated its software hours before a Sepolia test that will raise the amount of work each block can hold to 200 million gas.

news.title: Bitcoin keeps getting rejected at $87,000 as stocks hover near records
news.summary: BTC fell back to about $85,600 after sellers turned it away from $87,000 for the third time since Sept. 23, while Nasdaq closed at a record and Treasury yields kept climbing.

news.title: Solana Foundation unveils a program to settle institutional trades in seconds. JPMorgan gave input
news.summary: Solana Foundation launched an open-source program that lets institutions settle trades in seconds, not days. JPMorgan provided key inputs.

news.title: Crypto's campaign arm, Fairshake, sets lists of U.S. House favorites it'll spend on
news.summary: The super PAC shared a list of more than 30 incumbent candidates it's backing, with about a million dollars going to three names from each party.

news.title: Treasury withdraws crypto mixing rule, citing concerns over ‘chilling effect on legitimate activity’
news.summary: FinCEN is withdrawing a proposal that would've designated crypto mixing a "primary money laundering concern" under the PATRIOT Act.

news.title: More than 60 U.S. stocks including Nvidia and Tesla are headed onchain. Here’s how it works
news.summary: The planned 24/7 venue will offer dozens of tokenized U.S. stocks, with trades conducted against stablecoins through blockchain-based liquidity pools rather than a traditional order book.

news.title: Umia raises $6.1 million at $18 million FDV to help crypto projects launch tokens
news.summary: Umia raised $6.11 million through a seven-day auction of its UMIA token, with ten funds and nearly 700 individual bidders taking part.

news.title: CFTC proposes new federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trading
news.summary: The CFTC launched rulemaking on leveraged and margined retail crypto trading, proposing Regulation CTX and CAM and a new "crypto asset market" exchange.

news.title: U.S. CFTC joins SEC in proposing crypto regulations, though spot-market gap lingers
news.summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing two rules meant to cover the waterfront of crypto activity and exchanges, as long as it's not simple, direct trading.

news.title: Strive adds 2,000 bitcoin in biggest buy since June, closes in on MARA
news.summary: Strive’s bitcoin holdings near 30,000 BTC as the race among the largest public treasuries heats up.

news.title: DeFi Development sees NAV per share more than doubling, holds 2.56 million SOL
news.summary: DFDV says preliminary Q3 estimates show NAV per share more than doubled as its Solana treasury grew to 2.56 million SOL.

news.title: Stripe to expand stablecoin cards to over 100 countries by the end of the year
news.summary: The payments giant is planning a major global expansion for its stablecoin cards business, and is exploring tokenized deposits and DeFi use cases, new crypto head Henri Stern said.

news.title: An XRP treasury SPAC surges nearly 300% ahead of Evernorth merger
news.summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. II rose about 270% last week, leaving the thinly traded shell at nearly four times its roughly $10.50 trust value before merging with Evernorth, an XPR treasury company.
